localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description:
Group Camp 1 includes 2 electrical/water hook-up sites. These 2 sites are in addition to the 4 vehicles max allowed onsite. Vehicles in addition to the 4 allowed onsite must park at the Loop 4 restroom parking lot and are subject to a fee of $10/night per vehicle. Hook-up sites are back-in only. All tents must stay on defined tent pads. Group Camp 1 also includes covered, powered picnic shelter, barbeque, onsite private restrooms, and water spigot. Group Camp 1 is ADA accessible.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.

localizedValues.name: G2
localizedValues.description:
Parking for Group Camp 2 is located at the entrance to site and is 200 feet from actual camping area. 4 vehicles max allowed onsite. These vehicles must park to the right-hand side of parking area, in order to leave emergency access to site. Vehicles in addition to the 4 allowed onsite must park at the Loop 4 restroom parking lot and are subject to a fee of $10/night per vehicle.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.
